action: Decides when to retrieve for a series reference and window. The trigger and the host are not specified.
Calls the feed adapter for that series and window.
Invokes ObservationSourcePort (PT-06) to retrieve from the feed. Only the feed adapter does this.
validation_or_check: feed errors are handled by the adapter and are not core errors

action: Maps what it retrieved to the observation message schema and sets source_id, licence_ref, market, unit, class, basis, as_of and retrieved_at.
validation_or_check: optional convenience pre-checks; never trusted by the core

action: Submits the mapped batch with its verified tenant context and pack pin to submit_observations (OP-07). A batch names no tenant.
validation_or_check: the tenant is the verified context only
outcome_or_error: REQUEST_MALFORMED if a tenant field is present

action: Verifies the tenant context and the pack activation, then validates every item: required attributes, pack declarations, licence gate, value domain, time rules, size limits.
validation_or_check: authoritative; the only validation that counts

action: Appends the audit event, then stores accepted observations (content-addressed; identical content is a duplicate no-op) and returns per-item receipts.
Acts on the receipts. A retry of the same batch is safe because identical content is a duplicate.
Assessment reads only stored observations. It performs no retrieval and never calls a feed. A missing observation is an evidence gap.
validation_or_check: deterministic; no network, clock or feed
outcome_or_error: NOT_ASSESSED reasons inside a complete result
